requirements_before_any_new_gpu: Choose and document full-atom evaluation or a clearly scoped observed-interface evaluation before a new run.
Validate each actual source scaffold against the chosen evaluator atom-resolution requirements on CPU.
For strict full-atom evaluation, use a traceable complete input; do not relabel unresolved atoms as resolved.
If adopting scoped evaluation, independently freeze its implementation, exclusions and tests before generating new candidates.
Keep original strict failures, historical stage gates and retrospective diagnostic results unchanged.
Define a bounded terminal-conditioning comparison before spending additional GPU time; do not expand scaffold count automatically.
